newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt overnight, one-week pound rates narrow.
newsitem.headline: Egypt overnight, one-week pound rates narrow.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound narrowed in a short private sector market on Sunday to between 10 1/4 and 10 3/8 percent from Thursday's range of 9 1/4 and 10 3/8 percent, bankers said.
They said one-week rates were also higher at between 10 3/8 and 10 1/2 percent from 9 1/2 and 10 1/2 percent.
The market is usually tight on Sunday, the first day of trading after the Friday-Saturday weekend.
State-owned banks maintained their minimum overnight lending rate at 10 1/2 percent.
